meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求审查已完成工作时，Claude会启动5个并行子代理，分别检查目标/约束符合性、代码质量、安全性、手动QA执行和上下文（如GitHub/Slack），全部通过才算通过。
howto.when: 当你说出“review work”、“review my work”、“review changes”、“QA my work”等关键词，或要求审查已完成工作时触发。建议在PR提交前使用。

say.note: 启动全部5个代理进行完整审查
重点进行手动测试和验证
检查目标是否达成和约束是否满足

howto.what_en: When you ask to review completed work, Claude launches 5 parallel sub-agents: goal/constraint verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA, and context mining. All must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', etc., or when you ask to review completed work. Should be used before a PR handoff.

say_en.note: Launches all 5 sub-agents for full review
Focuses on hands-on testing and verification
